title: ZAINAB JIGAR FIGAAR JAHA'N SE GUZAR GAYI
body:
Beto'n ko jisne Bhai pa qurbaan kar diya
Laashe jab Aaye Shukr ka Sajda Adaa kiya
Aisa muzahira kabhi dekha na sabr ka
Sarwar ki Ghamgusaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<MINI>>
Zainab jigar figaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Baazu the reesma'n me bandhe baddua na ki
BhaiBhatije qatl huwe baddua na ki
Ahle haram ke khaime jale baddua na ki
Bhai ki Ja'nNisaar jahan se guzar gayi
<<MINI>>
Zainab jigar figaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho kar aseer koocha 0 bazaar me gayi
Kunbe ko leke majlis e ghadaar me gayi
Sar nange jo yazeed ke darbaar me gayi
Mehzoon-oDil figaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<MINI>>
Zainab jigar figaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Khutba Ali ke Lehje me jis ne suna diya
Darbaar ko yazeed ke jis ne hila diya
Tha haq pa kaun jis ne jaha'n ko bataaa diya
Haq baino Hag Sheyaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<MINI>>
Zainab jigar figaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham Shakl-e Mustafa ka jo Maatam na kar saki
Abbase BaWafa ka jo Maatam na kar saki
Mazloom e Karbala ka jo Maatam na kar saki
Kunbe ki sogwaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<MINI>>
Zainab jigar figaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Thi Haidari jalaal ki tasweer shaam me
Ki Maqsade Hussain ki Tash'heer shaam me
Rakhi Binaaye Majlise Shabbir shaam me
Maatam ki zimmedaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<MINI>>
Zainab jigar figaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaalim ne belche se Jise kar diya Shaheed
Kaise kahu'n jo Uspa mazaalim huwe Shadeed
Dil kaampta ha zapt ka yara nahi'n Saeed
Zehra ki Yaadgaar jaha'n se guzar gayi
<<MINI>>
